d: PSA BDP, a member of the PSA Group, is a leading provider of globally integrated and port-centric supply chain, transportation, and logistics solutions. The company is headquartered in Philadelphia, PA, and employs more than 5,500 people worldwide. We are a team that celebrates our unique diversity and close-knit community atmosphere.

Our core values begin at the very top and span the broad reach of our global community. We offer dynamic careers for those individuals looking to be a part of something bigger and provide unequivocal opportunities for growth within the organization.

PSA BDP serves over 5,000 customers, including some of the world's leading multinational companies within the chemical, retail & consumer, life sciences & pharmaceuticals, and electric vehicle & industrial verticals.

This role is responsible for coordinating and supporting day to day Contract Logistics operations in UAE, ensuring customer orders, warehouse activities, inventory movements and related logistics services are completed accurately, safely and within agreed service levels.

The role supports the end-to-end operational flow from inbound receiving and inventory management through order fulfilment, dispatch and delivery coordination, while maintaining accurate system records, documentation and operational reporting.
Coordinate daily inbound and outbound Contract Logistics activities based on customer requirements.
Monitor receiving, put away, picking, packing, staging and dispatch activities to ensure orders are processed accurately and on time.
Coordinate customer orders and monitor fulfilment through to delivery.
Maintain accurate inventory records and support cycle counts, stock reconciliation and investigation of discrepancies.
Coordinate with transport providers for collections, deliveries and shipment status updates.
Ensure operational transactions, customer orders and inventory movements are accurately recorded in WMS or other relevant systems.
Prepare and maintain operational documentation, shipment records and supporting documents.
Monitor customer requirements, SLA performance and operational exceptions, escalating issues where required.
Respond to customer operational queries and provide timely updates on orders, inventory and deliveries.
Prepare operational reports covering order volumes, inventory, deliveries, productivity and service performance.
Support billing activities by ensuring operational data and supporting documentation are complete and accurate.
Identify operational issues, support corrective actions and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to improve service, productivity and operational efficiency.
Ensure compliance with company procedures, customer requirements, health and safety standards and applicable regulations.
q: Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration or related field.
3 to 5 years of experience in Contract Logistics, Warehousing, Freight Forwarding or a related logistics environment.
Experience in inventory management, order fulfilment and warehouse operations.
Experience With WMS, TMS Or Other Logistics Systems Preferred.
Good Microsoft Office and Excel skills.
